content:
**Ally: Needs of the Many** is an ally quest for Beckett in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

Go to the Ammo Dump and retrieve the poison supply. Bring it back to Beckett to complete the quest. Retrieving it is easy as the ammo dump is lightly guarded by only a pair of Turrets and a single Blood Eagle with their attack dog.
